characters.description: The Malefic Viper's Chosen leads a five-person party through Nevermore. After the group completes floor 70, he favors difficult solo trials as the best route to further growth.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's wind-affinity companion and the highest-level member of the party. She joins the group's decision to pause their regular Nevermore progress and pursue individual challenge dungeons.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: The party's healer and plant specialist. She joins the group's decision to pause their regular Nevermore progress and pursue individual challenge dungeons.
characters.name: Dina

characters.description: The party's veteran swordsman. He remains with Jake's group as its members decide to pause their regular Nevermore progress for individual challenge dungeons.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: A force-and-soul combatant in Jake's Nevermore party. He joins the group's decision to pursue individual challenge dungeons.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron. He monitors the Nevermore run, advises Jake about his fading union oath with Sylphie, and directs him into the Colosseum to settle a wager.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: A friendly young spear fighter who registers in the Colosseum alongside Jake. He says his father trained him and appears to be a native participant in the challenge.
characters.name: Owen

characters.description: An elven noblewoman and aspiring sorcerer who approaches Jake after an earlier loss. She offers information, contacts, and practical assistance as he advances.
characters.name: Polly

characters.description: The Colosseum title imposed on Jake after his repeated kick-based victories.
characters.name: Doomfoot

characters.description: The Colosseum official who imposed Jake's Doomfoot title. He oversees advancement, schedules promotion bouts, and confirms rank changes.
characters.name: Battlemaster

characters.description: An unbeaten human martial artist selected as Jake's exceptional promotion opponent. His record and unusual placement mark him as a far greater challenge than the rank normally provides.
characters.name: Benevolent Monk

characters.description: Nevermore's host and the maker of its labyrinth challenge. He watches Jake's unusual Colosseum progress with the Malefic Viper and comments on opponents whose placement exceeds ordinary expectations.
characters.name: Minaga

characters.description: A Valhall-associated entrant whose performance in the Colosseum draws attention from the divine observers monitoring Nevermore.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: An undefeated dwarven earth mage selected as Jake's Master Gladiator promotion opponent. He fights with stone defenses, stone spears, and movement through sand.
characters.name: Earthborn Faithful

characters.description: An elven spellblade selected as Jake's bonus Master Gladiator promotion opponent. The image uses light and fire magic and is based on a god of the Altmar Empire.
characters.name: Emberlight Blademaster

characters.description: A Nevermore competitor whose usual fighting style translates poorly to the Colosseum arena.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: An undefeated Fae illusionist selected for Jake's Warlord promotion match. Her mental and illusion magic conceal a lethal strike, but she has limited physical ability.
characters.name: Living Nightmare

characters.description: A newly C-grade high elf and disciple of Duskleaf who returns to the clan she left behind. She now has enough standing to confront the circumstances of her past on her own terms.
characters.name: Mira

characters.description: The divine authority who explains that Colosseum opponents are system-assisted, level-zero images derived from other beings. He also confirms that selected victors may receive a private message after a match.
characters.name: Worm God

characters.description: Duskleaf's high-elf disciple publicly returns to the Willowwood clan as Mistress Dawnleaf. An Order representative announces that she has claimed the clan.
characters.name: Dawnleaf

characters.description: Dawnleaf's mother, a widowed jeweler supporting three younger children while facing heavy work demands from the Willowwood clan's tax system.
characters.name: Delia

characters.description: A historic Valhall warrior, war god, and Gudrun's husband. His reputation establishes him as an exceptionally powerful figure from humanity's past.
characters.name: Valdemar

characters.description: A spear fighter and meticulous strategist who prepares specialized counters for each opponent. Jake identifies the Valkyrie as Gudrun, Valdemar's wife, during his Champion promotion match.
characters.name: Gudrun

characters.description: One of the seven champions named when Jake gains access to the Gauntlet of the Grand Champion. At this point, the opponent is known only by the Necromancer title.
characters.name: Necromancer

characters.description: The Necromancer is identified as a weakened image of this risen general after killing Jake in their first gauntlet fight.
characters.name: Undying General

characters.description: A champion of shadow magic whom Jake must face during the gauntlet. Her favorable and unfavorable matchups are severe enough to discourage challengers from attempting only part of the sequence.
characters.name: Mistress of Shadows

characters.description: A semi-retired former general and champion who has mastered an extensive range of weapons. Advance research finds no known magic and little dependable information about his full arsenal.
characters.name: Warmaster

characters.description: The Colosseum official is revealed as the retired Warmaster when Jake learns the identity of his final champion opponent.
characters.name: Battlemaster

characters.description: Owen's father and one of the Colosseum's seven champions. Owen asks Jake to defeat him without killing him so that he can return home.
characters.name: Lightning Monarch

characters.description: Polly's former teacher and one of the Colosseum's seven champions. Polly says he forced her into service by threatening her parents and asks Jake to kill his image.
characters.name: Archmage

characters.description: One of the Colosseum's seven champions. Advance research describes her as a beastkin fire mage who also uses illusion magic.
characters.name: Phoenix Queen

characters.description: The shadow champion is identified as Umbra and connected to the Court of Shadows. Her matchup is among the obstacles Jake must consider during the champion gauntlet.
characters.name: Umbra

characters.description: An archer champion selected as Jake's next gauntlet opponent after his fourth victory. At this point, the figure is known only by the Lord of the Hunt title.
characters.name: Lord of the Hunt

characters.description: The hunter champion gives her name as Artemis after surrendering to Jake. She offers him recovery, practical observations about the remaining champions, and limited respect between fellow hunters.
characters.name: Artemis

characters.description: A divine figure who accompanies Artemis to the gathering at Nevermore. Artemis lacks the standing to attend the assembly of primordials without such support.
characters.name: Nature's Attendant

characters.description: An Earth administrator who has spent much of her development on governing and professional work. With integration stabilizing and local responsibilities increasingly delegated, she prepares to focus on combat growth again.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: An Earth-side overseer who helps manage construction, integration, and the growing role of freed arrivals. He has recently advanced into C-grade.
characters.name: Hank

characters.description: An empathic Test of Character entrant whose near-perfect result comes from understanding each scenario and guiding its people through empathy, logic, and adaptation.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: An analytical competitor whose Test of Character choices are remarkably impartial and consistently benefit the people whose lives he inhabits. His unquestionable result earns the challenge's highest standard reward.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: A figure whose plans are targeted by a coordinated deception presenting Valhall and the Malefic Order as hostile factions.
characters.name: Yip of Yore

characters.description: A karma mage and heretic investigating a homeworld whose loyalties appear distorted by false karmic premises. Free from his former controller, he intends to gather proof before leaving.
characters.name: William

characters.description: The Boundless Hydra's chosen, capable of opening wormholes and exploiting weaknesses in spatial barriers. Training intended to control exit points reveals a possible hunger-guided method of navigation.
characters.name: Sandy

characters.description: The sole true royal of her lineage and one of Jake's creations. She plans to leave the Endless Empire for the 93rd universe even though other royals initially fear the danger and political consequences.
characters.name: Vesperia

characters.description: The confidential architect of the House of the Architect. She offers Jake privacy from outside observation and reveals herself as the bound god whose existence sustains the living dungeon.
characters.name: Nevermore

characters.description: An escaped half-elf servant with innate curse energy, ties to a weak resistance group, and intense hatred for his former owner. Jake recruits him as an alchemy student instead of returning him.
characters.name: Half-Elf Servant

characters.description: The half-elf whom Jake recruits as his first formal student. Temlat chooses instruction in alchemy and curse control as a path toward strength and revenge rather than a return to enslavement.
characters.name: Temlat
